description: This file defines the 'Cart' controller class within the OpenCart system, handling API actions related to the shopping cart such as adding products, retrieving product details, and calculating totals. It interfaces with models for products and cart management, and manages validation, stock checking, and subscription options.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class for API-based shopping cart operations, including adding products, fetching cart contents, and calculating totals within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles API requests to update the cart with multiple products, including validation and error handling, then returns success or error messages.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a single product to the cart based on provided POST data, with validation and success/error reporting.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves current products in the cart, including subscription details, returning as an array.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Calculates and returns the totals of the cart including taxes, formatted as an array.
